summary: Russia conducted a massive overnight air attack on Ukraine employing newly introduced jet-powered "Banderol" Shahed-type drones, striking multiple oblasts including Kyiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, Kirovohrad, and Odesa. Multiple impacts were reported on Kyiv infrastructure, including warehouses in the Goloseevskyi and Boryspil districts, a thermal power plant (ТЕЦ-6), and ATB storage facilities. Concurrently, Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs at Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts.
key_points: Russia deployed jet-powered "Banderol" Shahed-type drones (300-500 km/h, ~500 km range, 135 kg warhead) in a massive overnight attack affecting multiple oblasts. (Source: @eRadarrua/109085)

Multiple impacts confirmed in Kyiv region: warehouses in Goloseevskyi district and near Boryspil, ATB storage facilities burning, and a reactor Shahed reported falling on ТЕЦ-6. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32866)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs at Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts simultaneously with the drone barrage. (Source: @kpszsu/75549)
Ukrainian drone operators struck a Sandora juice warehouse in Mykolaiv region reportedly being used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) for storage. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32868)
AFU drone operators from the Southern Group targeted AFU logistics infrastructure in Druzhkovka and Malotaranovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32875)
Odessa regional authorities confirmed a strike on a Nova Poshta terminal; jet-powered drones attacked from the Black Sea toward Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32877)
Ukraine faces a $27 billion military funding deficit this year, according to Defense Minister Khmara. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32869)

Former Defense Minister Fedorov stated the war in Ukraine could last at least another two to three years, citing Russia's position as the main obstacle to halting hostilities. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32871)

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a massive overnight air attack on Ukraine employing newly introduced jet-powered "Banderol" Shahed-type drones, striking multiple oblasts including Kyiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, Kirovohrad, and Odesa. Multiple impacts were reported on Kyiv infrastructure, including warehouses in the Goloseevskyi and Boryspil districts, a thermal power plant (ТЕЦ-6), and ATB storage facilities. Concurrently, Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs at Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts.

points: Ukrainian air defenses faced a saturation test as jet-powered "Banderol" Shahed-type drones (300-500 km/h, ~500 km range, 135 kg warhead) were deployed from multiple vectors including Bryansk and across the Black Sea. Air raid alerts in Kyiv lasted approximately 3.5 hours (05:13 to 08:45) and resumed later in the morning. (Source: @eRadarrua/109085)

Multiple impacts were confirmed in Kyiv region: warehouses in the Goloseevskyi district and near Boryspil, ATB storage facilities burning, and a reactor Shahed reported falling on ТЕЦ-6. Civilian air defense infrastructure was overwhelmed by the density of incoming targets across Kyiv districts including Darnytsia, Obolon, and Troyeshchyna. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72629)

Ukraine faces a severe military funding crisis with Defense Minister Khmara announcing a $27 billion deficit this year, potentially limiting defensive capacity against the escalating Russian aerial campaign. Former Defense Minister Fedorov stated the war could last another 2-3 years with Russia blocking ceasefire terms. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32869)

British defense firms supplying Ukraine, including BAE Systems (Storm Shadow), Callen-Lenz, and Ukrspecsystems, have been warned of Russian intelligence threats. Companies face operational security risks while sustaining critical weapons deliveries. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32865)

Odessa regional authorities confirmed a strike on a Nova Poshta terminal; the Black Sea-based jet drone attack prompted concerns about supply chain disruptions. Local residents reported food shortages and shipping halts due to safety risks. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32877)

AFU drone operators from the Southern Group targeted AFU logistics infrastructure in Druzhkovka and Malotaranovka. A warehouse of juice manufacturer Sandora in Mykolaiv region reportedly used by the AFU was struck and caught fire. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32868)

Russia introduced jet-powered "Banderol" Shahed-type drones into serial production, capable of 300-500 km/h, ~500 km range, and carrying 135 kg warheads. Production is reportedly 35% cheaper than previous models, with mass deployment expected by 2027. (Source: @eRadarrua/109085)

Russian forces launched guided aerial bombs at Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts using tactical aviation during the same operational window as the drone barrage, complicating Ukrainian air defense allocation. (Source: @kpszsu/75549)

Russian drone operators targeted AFU logistics in Druzhkovka and Malotaranovka, indicating persistent ISR and strike capability deep in contested rear areas. Reports indicate the Sandora warehouse in Mykolaiv region was being used by AFU forces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32875)

Russian intelligence services (GRU/SVR) reportedly threatened British defense companies supplying weapons and drones to Ukraine, including BAE Systems, Callen-Lenz, and Ukrspecsystems, indicating an expanded hybrid warfare posture. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32865)

Russian air defenses reportedly struck a residential high-rise building in Yekaterinburg, illustrating domestic air defense fratricide or malfunction during heightened operational tempo. (Source: @eRadarrua/109122)

Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs at Donetsk Oblast during the overnight barrage, maintaining pressure on the eastern front while air operations saturated Ukrainian defenses. (Source: @kpszsu/75542)
Russian drone operators targeted AFU logistics in Druzhkovka (Donetsk Oblast), striking supply lines that sustain forward defensive positions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32875)
The full operational scope of ground engagements on the eastern front is not detailed in current message traffic, which focuses predominantly on aerial operations. (Source: @kpszsu/75542)

Chernihiv Oblast experienced intense drone activity, with targets tracked heading toward Kyiv region via Lyubech and multiple unidentified drones approaching Mena, Desna, Honcharivske, and Kozelets. Air defenses engaged threats moving southward into Kyiv Oblast. (Source: @eRadarrua/109083)

Kyiv region was the primary target of the overnight operation, with jet-powered drones approaching from Bryansk via Chernihiv and separately from the south via Hostomel. Threats were tracked over the Kyiv reservoir moving toward the capital, with impacts reported across Darnytsia, Obolon, Troyeshchyna, and the Livoberezhnyi district. (Source: @kpszsu/75528)

Air raid alerts in Kyiv were issued at 05:13 and 07:56, with the first all-clear at 08:45 and subsequent alerts at 10:19, indicating a prolonged and complex aerial engagement across multiple vectors. (Source: @eRadarrua/109051)

Dnipropetrovsk Oblast was targeted by both jet-powered drones heading westward (past Yurieve) and guided aerial bombs from Russian tactical aviation, with impact reported at a meat processing plant in Kamianske. (Source: @kpszsu/75549)

Mykolaiv Oblast faced drone incursions from the south, with targets tracked toward Bashtanka. Separately, a Sandora juice warehouse reportedly used by the AFU was struck and caught fire. (Source: @kpszsu/75550)

Zaporizhzhia Oblast was hit by Russian guided aerial bombs, while jet-powered drones approached the regional capital from southern and eastern vectors. Reports indicate AFU drone activity near Enerhodar and Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant continues, with the station on day 12 of external power disconnection. (Source: @kpszsu/75543)

A jet-powered drone attack was launched toward Odesa Oblast (Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi district) from the Black Sea, and regional authorities confirmed a strike on a Nova Poshta terminal. (Source: @kpszsu/75520)

The defining feature was the introduction of jet-powered Shahed-type drones ("Banderol") with significantly higher speeds (300-500 km/h) than conventional propeller drones (100 km/h), drastically reducing reaction time for air defenses and air raid warnings. (Source: @eRadarrua/109085)

Multiple oblasts were engaged simultaneously: Kyiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, Kirovohrad, and Odesa. Specific drone concentrations included Kirovohrad (2 groups), Poltava (4 groups), and tracks toward Novi Sanzhary, Novomirgorod, and Myronivka. (Source: @eRadarrua/109127)

Russian tactical aviation employed guided aerial bombs across three oblasts (Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk, Dnipropetrovsk) during the same operational window, creating a complex air defense problem mixing low-altitude drones and high-altitude bombing runs. (Source: @kpszsu/75542)

Civilian and infrastructure impacts in Kyiv included a strike on ТЕЦ-6 (thermal power plant), warehouses in Goloseevskyi district, storage facilities near Boryspil, and ATB retail warehouses. Debris damage was reported across multiple Kyiv districts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72629)

key_developments: Russia deployed jet-powered "Banderol" Shahed-type drones (300-500 km/h, 135 kg warhead, ~500 km range) in a mass overnight attack spanning eight oblasts. (Source: @eRadarrua/109085)
Confirmed impacts in Kyiv: ТЕЦ-6 thermal plant struck by a reactor drone; warehouses burned in Goloseevskyi district and near Boryspil; ATB storage facilities ablaze. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72629)
Russian tactical aviation simultaneously launched guided aerial bombs at Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts, saturating air defenses. (Source: @kpszsu/75549)
Drone attacks tracked across Poltava (4 groups toward Novi Sanzhary), Kirovohrad (2 groups toward Novomirgorod), and Mykolaiv (toward Bashtanka). (Source: @eRadarrua/109127)
Odessa regional authorities confirmed a strike on a Nova Poshta terminal; jet drones attacked Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi district from the Black Sea. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32877)
A meat processing plant in Kamianske (Dnipropetrovsk Oblast) was hit, and a Sandora warehouse in Mykolaiv region reportedly used by the AFU caught fire. (Source: @UkraineNow/83792)
Ukraine faces a $27 billion military funding deficit this year per Defense Minister Khmara, threatening sustained resistance to the intensified air campaign. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32869)
sections.threat_assessment: Russia has significantly escalated its aerial campaign against Ukraine by deploying jet-powered Shahed-type drones capable of cruise-missile speeds (300-500 km/h), drastically compressing Ukrainian air defense reaction windows. The simultaneous use of these drones, conventional propeller drones, and guided aerial bombs across at least eight oblasts indicates a deliberate saturation strategy targeting critical infrastructure (ТЕЦ-6), logistics hubs (Nova Poshta, ATB warehouses), and military storage (Sandora facility). The $27 billion military funding deficit combined with the 2-3 year war outlook suggests Ukraine faces a protracted attritional conflict with diminishing defensive capacity against increasingly sophisticated Russian aerial threats.
sections.regional_response: The unprecedented scale of the overnight attack triggered immediate civilian air raid responses across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Kirovohrad, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts, with multiple alerts issued within hours. Civilian complaints emerged regarding food supply disruptions in Ivano-Frankivsk, Vinnytsia, and Odessa, indicating secondary economic pressure from sustained infrastructure strikes. Diplomatic channels remain active, with CIA Director Ratcliffe proposing a Trump-Putin-Zelensky summit during a Moscow visit, though Russia's negotiating position continues to block substantive ceasefire terms according to Ukrainian officials.
sections.intelligence_notes: The deployment of jet-powered "Banderol" drones represents a qualitative escalation in Russian deep-strike capability, with production reportedly 35% cheaper than predecessors and mass deployment planned by 2027. Reports of imminent Russian serial production of "Dan" type drones (longer range, ~500 km, 135 kg warhead) suggest continued escalation in UAV strike capacity. Russian intelligence threats against British defense firms (BAE Systems, Callen-Lenz, Ukrspecsystems) indicate a hybrid warfare expansion targeting Western supply chains critical to Ukrainian defense. Domestic Russian air defense malfunctions (Yekaterinburg high-rise strike) may reflect operational strain from the intensified tempo of Ukrainian retaliatory drone operations, as evidenced by recent strikes on Belgorod infrastructure including a TV tower.
